---
title: "Interactive map"
subtitle: "Drive time from every populated square kilometre to the nearest hospital"
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("dashboard/_common.R")
```

```{r}
#| label: toolbar
#| output: asis
if (atlas_ready) cat(map_toolbar_html(atlas_summary)) else not_built()
```

```{r}
#| label: map
#| eval: !expr atlas_ready
library(leaflet)
overlays <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(web_dir, "overlays.json"))
cats <- atlas_summary$categories
cat_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cats)), function(i) as.list(cats[i, ]))
js <- paste(readLines("assets/map.js", warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")
m <- leaflet(
  width = "100%", height = "72vh",
  options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE, zoomSnap = 0.5, minZoom = 4, maxZoom = 13)
) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, options = providerTileOptions(detectRetina = TRUE)) |>
  fitBounds(44, 25, 63.5, 39.8)
htmlwidgets::onRender(m, js, data = list(
  base = "data/",
  overlays = overlays,
  categories = cat_rows,
  national = atlas_summary$national,
  palette = list(travel = atlas_summary$palette_travel, population = atlas_summary$palette_population)
))
```

```{r}
#| label: panel
#| output: asis
if (atlas_ready) {
  cat('<div class="map-panel"><div id="atlas-legend" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="atlas-stats" aria-live="polite"></div></div>')
}
```

Tap a province to select it. **Accessibility categories** dims areas inside the chosen threshold so the places beyond it stand out. Raster layers are pre-rendered in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857); analysis is done in EPSG:4326.
